title: Delightful Umami Delight
description: A simple recipe showcasing umami flavors with a delightful twist.
instructions: Chill the workout water in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped crisp lettuce and crushed low-carb crackers.
Drizzle the vesy vinegar over the lettuce mixture and toss to coat.
Add the umami and delight seasoning (if using) and toss gently.
Just before serving, pour the chilled workout water over the salad and serve immediately.
Enjoy your delicious and refreshing umami delight!
